ian: Heads-up: release train update — brief notice about a freeze window and a contingency canary tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

lee: what's the scope of the freeze?

ian: Effective immediately for 48h: no schema, cache, or router config merges to prod without a freeze-exception. This is precautionary after yesterday's routing flaps.

sophie: can teams still ship non-infra bugfixes?

ian: yes, non-infra fixes OK. If you think you need an exception, open a PR tagged 'freeze-exception' and ping @ian + #eng-oncall. We'll triage quickly.

release-bot: [scheduled] Contingency canary: 2026-07-01 14:00:00 UTC. Slot length: 90m. Auto-rollback thresholds: 5xx_rate>0.6% or p95 latency +20%.

oncall-bot: [note] Incident summary (routing flaps): root cause = faulty BGP config in edge; impact = elevated error rate for ~10m. Postmortem draft: /linked/postmortems/routing-flap-2026-06-28.

lee: we'll delay our router ACL change. I'll update the PR.

sophie: I'll add extra health-checks to our serving-runtime rollout checklist.

ian: thanks. Two action items: 1) teams with infra touches hold merges until exception approved, 2) owners confirm readiness for the canary in this thread by EOD.

lee: confirmed held.

sophie: readiness ok — will run smoke at 13:15 UTC.

ian: good. Keep comms here and in #eng-oncall during the canary. If emergency, escalate to me directly. :thumbsup:
